answer: The umber schedule is applied in basalt and wander makes public each instalment. A payout is split thus 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4789 identities would post 4176 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
